threads.body: Accessing `Configuration.baggageEnabled` here initializes the entire nested `Configuration`, including `contextDataKeys`. Because this SPI runs for every Log4j event, an ordinary no-span/no-baggage log emitted before `GlobalOpenTelemetry` is installed now permanently computes both fields from the no-op instance; later declarative baggage or custom logging-key configuration is then ignored. Preserve the holder's lazy initialization by checking the current baggage for emptiness before touching `Configuration`, and gate baggage insertion separately.

replies.body: Good catch, fixed in 018e4ac. `Baggage.fromContext` doesn't need any config, so the early return no longer touches `Configuration`, and `baggageEnabled` is read at the insertion site instead. Lazy init is back to what it was before this PR.
